title: Cardinal of Como (papal Secretariat) to Anselmo Dandini, nuncio in France, 1580 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 283C, DECODE R72-R73)

documents.shelfmark: ASV Segreteria di Stato, Francia 283C, f. 52 (DECODE R72)

plaintext.source: Contemporary decipherment written in clear below the figures on f. 52.

transcription.source: SofPe 2019 transcription (DOC_R72_D1824), 1060 digits by the profile checker, parsed into groups by decrypt_r72.py
transcription.notes: Group count from the parse (509 tokens including 11 nomenclator groups and a few single-digit misreads); not re-transcribed.

documents.shelfmark: ASV Segreteria di Stato, Francia 283C, ff. 89r-90r (DECODE R73)

plaintext.source: George Lasry's decryption on DECODE (DOC_R72_D3191 / DOC_R73_D3193, key DOC_R72_D3190, Oct 2020).

transcription.source: KaJo 2017 transcription (DOC_R73_D1789) as decrypted by Lasry
transcription.notes: Groups counted by script in Lasry's decryption file; 32 illegible. Paper damaged, bleed-through.

system.summary: Two-digit letter homophones (second digit even in R73) and three-digit nomenclator groups closed by a mark; R72 shares the frame and nomenclator but reassigns the letter codes.
system.notes: R72 letter key recovered here by annealing in Lasry's R73 frame; R72 unread groups 766^, 866^, 030^, 448^; R73 866^, 466^, 766^, 324^, 300^.

prior_solution.where: R72: contemporary decipherment on the leaf. R73: Lasry's decryption and key on DECODE (Oct 2020).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE R72-R73 metadata, 4 page images, 11 DOC images and 6 DOC text files fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R73 decryption found on the records.
Lasry's reconstructed key applied to the R72 transcription (DP parse). Parse fits the frame (only code 38 unknown) but the letters are nonsense: different letter assignment.
Homophonic annealing on a naive 2-digit tokenisation of R72. Free assignment collapsed to a constant string; fixed-multiset swaps did not converge (misaligned tokens).

Swap annealing of letter values on the DP parse, nomenclator words fixed as plaintext, Italian 4-grams from it-renaissance. Readable Italian at once: 'la voce et l'opinione della pratica ... con la monaca e uscita tanto publica'.
Clear block at the foot of f. 52 transcribed and recognised as the contemporary decipherment; decryption aligned with it, three codes corrected (22 l, 62 e, 72 i).

outcome.method_basis: R72 has its contemporary decipherment written out below the figures on f. 52, and R73 was already decrypted by Lasry on DECODE (D3191, key D3190, 2020); the project transcribed and checked these, and separately rebuilt R72's different letter key by annealing inside Lasry's frame and nomenclator, corrected against the leaf's decipherment.
outcome.notes: R72 read (contemporary decipherment confirmed by the recovered key); R73 read by Lasry, 32 illegible groups and 5 nomenclator groups open.
